answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 48 POA per identity, released only after 10 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 380 fakes must lock 18240 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. What carries the crystal here is verification, the ocean of cost is what stops the farm, and the plume of the record keeps every claim checkable.
